chamber_options.option: 1. Machined 6061 through-frame + bolted floor plate (the design now)
chamber_options.cost: 3,896 at BYU (stock $2,278 + 24.9 h x $65); outside: floor $83.68 (JLCCNC), frame manual quote (estimate $400-1,500), US job shop $4,000-10,
chamber_options.lead: 3-4 days on the VF-4 inside the shop queue; JLCCNC 6-7 days + 2-4 days UPS

chamber_options.option: 2a. Printed 316L by LPBF, frame + floor as one body, seal faces, bores and threads machined after
chamber_options.cost: $4,826.37 (JLC3DP live quote, before review) + ~$270 UPS DDP (estimate from its $180-453 shipping lines) + 10-14 h of finishing at BYU; outs
chamber_options.lead: 3-day build + review + 2-4 business days UPS: about 1.5-2 weeks (JLC3DP; 'about
chamber_options.verdict: workable: $1,980 more than machining at $65/h ($5,876 against $3,896) for 11-15 h less shop time

chamber_options.option: 2b. Printed aluminium by LPBF (JLC3DP 'Aluminum 6061'; AlSi10Mg elsewhere), one body, machined after
chamber_options.cost: $2,916.58 (JLC3DP live, before review) + shipping; US AlSi10Mg $8-25k (estimate)
chamber_options.verdict: workable: about the same money as machining at $65/h ($3,767 against $3,896) for 13-17 h less shop time; a backup if the VF-4 queue is the bottleneck, after a design-for-AM pass and a first-article helium test

chamber_options.option: 3. DED (wire-arc or laser-wire) 316L walls on a 316L floor plate, machined all over
chamber_options.cost: $4,000-12,000 including machining (helper's estimate); Edison $3,000-8,000 + significant machining

chamber_options.option: 4. Welded box from cut plate (316L or 5083), seal faces machined after welding
chamber_options.cost: $1,200-3,500 (Edison r7 estimate: plate, cutting, 8-15 h of TIG, post-weld machining); SendCutSend cuts 6061 to 0.75 in., 304/5052 to 0.5 in
chamber_options.lead: 2-4 weeks (estimate), plus a qualified welder's queue
chamber_options.verdict: no: the same machining plus weld risk (chamber-construction.md option 4)

chamber_options.cost: Ideal Vacuum 6 x 12 x 12 in. short cube kit P109160 $4,150.04 (sale; 291 x 291 x 138 mm inside, ~336 x 336 x 184 outside); LACO 12 in. cube

chamber_options.option: 6. Purge-only enclosure (no vacuum): extrusion or sheet with gaskets
chamber_options.cost: $500-1,500 for extrusion, panels and gaskets (estimate); the ports, window and recoater bores still need machined plates
chamber_options.verdict: no for an aluminium-screening machine; it saves ~10 h and the pump

chamber_options.option: 7. Bolted box of six flat plates, O-rings in every joint
8. Casting (A356 sand cast from a printed mould, or investment-cast 316)
chamber_options.cost: $4,500-12,000 one-off with a pattern (Edison r7); a printed sand mould ~EUR 450 at EUR 9/L (helper's estimate) + pouring + machining; impreg
chamber_options.lead: 6-12 weeks (Edison r7 estimate); every foundry is quote-only
